slides.title: An Unshared Insight Has No Impact
bullets: A great insight that never reaches the right audience achieves nothing
Sharing deserves as much deliberate attention as generating and writing it
It is a distinct final step, not an afterthought

slides.title: Send Insight to the Right Owner, Not Just a System
bullets: Safety observations need immediate escalation through pharmacovigilance
That's a compliance obligation, not a judgment call
Evidence gaps go to the evidence-generation team, education gaps to education planning

slides.title: A Database Entry Alone Is a Passive Channel
bullets: Important insights often need an active nudge to be seen
A direct message or raising it in a team huddle helps
Especially critical when there's time pressure

slides.title: Frame the Same Insight Differently for Different Readers
bullets: A Medical Advisor needs the full data-to-implication chain and context
A cross-functional colleague needs a concise, decision-focused version
Sent through appropriately compliant, filtered channels

slides.title: Contribute to Collective Learning, Not Just Reporting
bullets: Communities of practice check one territory's pattern against others
Case discussions, insight reviews and congress debriefs do this work
This turns individual observation into validated, aggregated intelligence

slides.title: Feedback on Impact Reinforces Good Insight
bullets: When an insight visibly leads to action, tell the MSL who found it
This reinforces the behaviour that generates high-value insight
Good organisations make this feedback loop explicit, not left to chance

takeaway.title: Insight only creates value once it reaches the right person in the right form
bullets: Route insight to its proper owner, with safety escalated immediately
Frame the same insight differently for different internal audiences
Contribute to shared forums, and close the loop when insight leads to action
